title: 第五章 小哥哥快来玩儿啊第六章 我焯还有狱卒
slug: 镇守魔门圣女我每天暴涨一年功力
lines: 发完饭，江澜又打了个哈欠，沿着牢房，往外走去。
算算时间，已经两天了。
虽然这地方，没有后世那么人性化，但狱卒也是有休息的。
一般都是在牢里待两天，然后能歇一天。
当然，这一天是上午可以走，晚上还得回来那种。
正儿八经的做二休一，那是万万不可能滴。
别小瞧了剥削阶级啊！
不过，能出去喘口气，总归是好的。
自打到了这个破地方，江澜还没出去过呢。
虽然只有一天一夜，但江澜感觉，自己整个人都有点儿要发霉了。
休息休息。
出了甲字牢房，一路往前，江澜来到班房。
班房不大，几张条凳，一张破桌子，墙上还挂着手写的排班，以及几张通缉犯的画像。
这会儿，班房里头坐了三四个狱卒。
见到江澜进来，几人纷纷抬头，目露惊恐。
那眼神，就仿佛他是鬼一样。
“我超威！你居然还活着？”一个年纪和江澜差不多的狱卒低声惊叹一句。
江澜眼前一亮。
这小子挺有梗啊。
只不过，还没等他主动答话，班房大门便再次被打……踹开。
“哐当！”
王虎走进班房，眼睛里挂着两块眼屎，一副刚睡醒的样子。
看见江澜，他眼神一闪。
“诶呦我？”
“命这么硬？”
江澜笑眯眯道：
“托您的福，反正没死。”
他倒是想直接硬怼，但现在还不是时候。
江澜虽然平常颠了点儿，但在这种问题上，还是拎得很清的。
现在他只是个平平无奇的狱卒，王虎是他顶头上司。
要是他不犯事儿，王虎最多就是给他穿穿小鞋，恶心他一下。
但要是真犯到对方手上了，那指不定还有多少恶心人的手段等着他呢。
而且，他现在实力几乎是一天一个台阶。
有句话怎么说的？
君子报仇，十年不晚。
他也用不着等十年，十天就差不多了。
content_en:
After serving the meal, Jiang Lan yawned again and walked out along the cell.
Counting the time, it has been two days.
Although this place was not as humane as later generations, the jailers also had a chance to rest.
Usually they stay in jail for two days and then have one day off.
Of course, this is a day where you can leave in the morning and have to come back in the evening.
It is absolutely impossible to do two days off and one day off in a serious way.
Don’t underestimate the exploiting class!
However, it's always good to go out and take a breather.
Jiang Lan hasn't been out since he arrived at this poor place.
Although it was only one day and one night, Jiang Lan felt that his whole body was a little moldy.
Take a break.
After leaving the A-shaped cell and walking forward, Jiang Lan came to the prison cell.
The squad room is not big, with a few benches and a broken table. There are also handwritten schedules and several portraits of wanted criminals hanging on the wall.
At this moment, there were three or four jailers sitting in the cell.
Seeing Jiang Lan come in, several people raised their heads with horror in their eyes.
That look in his eyes was as if he were a ghost.
"I am super powerful! You are actually still alive?" A jailer about the same age as Jiang Lan exclaimed in a low voice.
Jiang Lan's eyes lit up.
This guy is quite clever.
However, before he could take the initiative to answer, the door to the class room was punched... kicked open again.
"Clang!"
Wang Hu walked into the class room with two pieces of eye droppings hanging in his eyes, as if he had just woken up.
When he saw Jiang Lan, his eyes flashed.
"Hey me?"
"Is life so hard?"
Jiang Lan smiled and said:
"Thanks to you, I'm not dead anyway."
He wanted to directly confront him, but now was not the time.
Although Jiang Lan is usually a little confused, he is still very clear on this kind of issue.
Now he is just an ordinary jailer, and Wang Hu is his immediate boss.
If he doesn't commit any crime, the most Wang Hu can do is give him some shoes to make him feel disgusted.
But if he really gets into the hands of the other party, there may be many more disgusting ways waiting for him.
Moreover, his strength is almost improving every day.
What's the saying?
A gentleman's revenge is never too late.
He didn't have to wait ten years, ten days would be enough.
title_en: Chapter 5: Little brother, come and play. Chapter 6: I'll blanch and there will be a jailer.
